payload.recallText: The dean at Fordham University wanted to bring in more high-class students. A reporter for the school paper wanted to interview the dean. During the interview, a man showed up and threw a pie in the dean's face. Afterwards, the school paper reporter wrote an embellished story about the man who threw the pie and portrayed him as a caped crusader named "Pie Man." The reporter ended up at a bar with a woman who he liked, and she asked him if he was pie man, and he lied and said yes so she would sleep with him.
